# Nexxau

> AI-powered PPE compliance monitoring platform for construction sites and warehouse operations. Nexxau uses real-time computer vision to detect missing personal protective equipment (hard hats, vests, gloves, goggles) and delivers instant violation alerts — helping safety managers prevent OSHA fines, reduce workers' comp claims, and fill coverage gaps left by foremen.

Nexxau integrates with existing on-site IP cameras via RTSP streams and runs a YOLO-based inference pipeline to continuously monitor job sites at scale. It is a SaaS product with per-worksite and per-camera subscription pricing, designed for general contractors, construction companies, and safety-conscious operations.

## Key Capabilities

- Real-time PPE detection via YOLO computer vision (hard hats, vests, gloves, goggles)
- RTSP camera ingestion with WebRTC live stream delivery to dashboard
- Instant violation alerts via email (with snapshot images attached)
- Supabase-backed violation logs with photo evidence for OSHA audit trails
- Multi-site, multi-camera dashboard with compliance overview
- Zone-based detection with speaker alert support
- Compliance PDF reports and shift summary emails (roadmap)
- Trends dashboard and analytics (roadmap)

## Target Customers

- General contractors and construction companies
- Safety managers and HSE officers
- Warehouse and logistics operations
- Companies subject to OSHA PPE standards (29 CFR 1926 Subpart E)

## Core Value Proposition

Nexxau is not just a "helmet detector." It is an OSHA fine prevention and liability reduction system. Key outcomes for customers:

- Avoid OSHA PPE violations (fines up to $16,131 per willful/repeat violation)
- Build a documented audit trail for compliance inspections
- Reduce workers' compensation claims from preventable PPE-related injuries
- Extend safety coverage beyond what on-site foremen can manually monitor

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: Next.js (React)
- Backend: Node.js / Express
- Inference: Python / Flask with YOLO object detection
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Storage: Supabase Storage (violation snapshots)
- Email alerts: Resend
- Inference hosting: Railway
- Frontend hosting: Vercel
- Stream ingestion: go2rtc (RTSP → WebRTC)

## Business Model

Subscription SaaS — per-worksite and per-camera pricing. Insurance partnership integrations planned as a compliance incentive channel.
